rationale: Both responses accurately read the signs: two ONE WAY signs, an angled Broadway sign, 'West 32nd St' with '40 - 2' above it, and 'Korea Way' with Korean characters. They also describe the buildings well: a glass facade and a light high-rise on the left, an ornate stone building with iron balconies on the right, and overhead wires. The key difference is the Broadway sign. A correctly says it is white text on dark blue, while B calls it purple/maroon, an inaccurate color attribute. B gets some details right, such as the notched top of the 32nd St sign, but A also correctly notes that the top ONE WAY sign is partly hidden by the Broadway sign. Neither mentions that the top sign's arrow points left. A is more accurate on the color error, which is the deciding point.
